import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_7.csv", index_col=0)
source8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_8.csv", index_col=0)
source9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_28/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# Step 1: Union all source tables with the same schema as source3 (which have ARPU column)
# These are source3, source5, source6, source7
# They share the same schema including 'ARPU' and 'ROW_WID'
union_dfs = [source3, source5, source6, source7]
union_all = pd.concat(union_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Remove duplicates in union_all on ROW_WID to avoid duplication in join
union_all = union_all.drop_duplicates(subset=['ROW_WID'])

# Step 2: Join union_all with all other source tables on ROW_WID
# Other source tables: source0, source1, source2, source4, source8, source9
# Join left on union_all to keep only rows with ARPU from union_all

merged = union_all.merge(source0, on='ROW_WID', how='left')
merged = merged.merge(source1, on='ROW_WID', how='left')
merged = merged.merge(source2, on='ROW_WID', how='left')
merged = merged.merge(source4, on='ROW_WID', how='left')
merged = merged.merge(source8, on='ROW_WID', how='left')
merged = merged.merge(source9, on='ROW_WID', how='left')

# Step 3: Project only the ARPU column as target schema requires only ['ARPU']
# Ensure ARPU is float type
Target9_28 = merged[['ARPU']].copy()
Target9_28['ARPU'] = Target9_28['ARPU'].astype(float)

# Step 4: Save the result to the specified path
Target9_28.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
